kind_of_no: long-stay park, no posted nightly rate or booking site (test 2)
why: Private park that bills itself as a 'Full-Time Seasonal RV Park' on its own site rivercitycampgroundsd.com (read 2026-11-22; 'Seasonal' was added in a 2026-01-06 edit, earlier captures say 'Full-Time RV Park'). It posts no rate anywhere, has no booking engine and books only by phone, email or contact form. A long-stay park needs a nightly rate on its own site or a booking site that sells one night (curation doc test 2; an RV Life tier can't stand in). RV Life also rates it $$$, so it has no price indicator for an ordinary park either.
name: River City Campground
flags: Operator site (WordPress, home page modified 2026-01-06, read 2026-11-22): title 'Full-Time RV park by the Missouri River', heading 'Full-Time Seasonal RV Park in Chamberlain, SD', 'Welcome to our locally owned, family-friendly full-time campground! ... Whether you're making our campground your home or just passing through', 'All sites require a reservation, contact us to book yours!', back-in full-hookup sites at 20/30/50 A. No rate, season or site count is given. The rules page allows decks 'not longer than the camper' and small gardens with owner approval, and bars skirting. Wayback captures 20240815193543 and 20250409171957 have the same text, minus 'Seasonal'.

Nights were sold in 2025. RV Life reviews (park 263601, API read 2026-11-22) report $45 and $50 one-night stays by motorhome, fifth wheel and travel trailer in May, Jul and Sep 2025 ('Reservered on phone then did a self check in paying'). A May 2026 review stayed 3 months. Reviews are mixed ('like camping in a parking lot', a one-room shower/toilet 'not clean'). RV Life has 4 stars from 13 ratings, $$$, avg_rate 50 and 95 sites. The nightly share is unmeasured: no count is published.

Google Maps 'River City Campground' (gm.py, read 2026-11-22): 4.4 from 32 reviews, pin 43.80833,-99.31456, phone +1 605-299-5833, site rivercitycampgroundsd.com, address 333 Prospect Ave. Presence is met; only the long-stay nightly-sale test fails.

Esri imagery (rendered, read 2026-11-22): a treeless gravel lot of about 70 back-in pads plus a pull-through row, between the BNSF rail line and a draw on the east edge of town. Few rigs show in the frame. It is not waterfront: the Missouri is about 1 km west.
Not in campgrounds.json by name or within ~2 km of the pin. The nearest entry is 15756 American Creek, about 1.6 km WNW. Checked 2026-11-22.
If AWH would rather keep it on the 2025 camper-reported $45-50 nights: the price meets the US$50 gate only narrowly, and no gateway was checked because the test-2 failure decided it.
